entities.summary: Ty Smith is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently playing under contract with HC Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted in the first round, 17th overall, in the 2018 NHL entry draft by the New Jersey Devils.
